selection: All complete promotion-journal records in fixed rounds775..5049, without kind/outcome/score filtering. All selected records are subsequently validated ordinary promotions. All182 pre-window records are excluded (85historical admissions and97earlier ordinary warm-up records).
derivation: Parse JSON numeric lexemes as Decimal; subtract old_utility from new_utility within each source record. Keep exact decimal values and every source-line identity; float conversion only for rendering.
source_record_hash_encoding: SHA256 of raw JSONL line including LF terminator
scope: Adaptive training-side admitted program/context records only; each increment uses that record's own previous and new utilities. Different contexts and incumbents must not be summed into a learning curve. Positivity is required by admission and does not estimate proposal-level success, adapter improvement or neural writer learning.
source_binding: Logged aggregate fields only; exact runtime, evaluation-population and normalization closure remain unqualified. No Elo, independent-learning or speed inference.

band_explanation.band_definition: Absolute difference from0.0005 <=5e-8 (equivalent here to rounding to7decimal places); this is a descriptive band, not exact equality.
band_explanation.complexity_measure: Count of opening parentheses in logged program DSL.
band_explanation.qualification: One fewer counted node in every band pair with a journaled incumbent. Prior incumbents without an exact journal match remain unpaired; this component-level explanation does not qualify whole runtime, input closure, checkpoints or independent learning.
band_explanation.explanation: The score adds0.0005 per counted opening parenthesis; utility negates the score. All390 band pairs with an exactly matched journaled incumbent reduce that count byone. The143remaining prior incumbents are unmatched; no decomposition is supplied for them.
